cost_of_load's bracket takes the last request before the load and the next after it, so any other tool result landing in the window is charged to the load -- 6f6c5410's 6,231 already carries 821 tokens of a Bash result in place at the Read's own request, and 5b2accfd's 5,889 spans two Reads issued together -- making both figures upper bounds; recorded rather than scored as a defect because the fence itself prescribes usage figures around the load and the gap note would not fire at these window sizes.
